attribution: Land Tirol, data.tirol.gv.at (TIRIS), Naturdenkmaeler Tirol, CC BY 4.0, extract of 2026-10-15
scope: 260 active Naturdenkmaeler points in Tyrol (about 198 with a tree in the name; the rest are lakes, bogs, gorges, waterfalls, caves, fossil sites) plus 45 revoked (NDW) rows kept in 'revoked' as a dead-tree list.
caveat: Fields are name, designation date and legal source only: no species Latin name, girth, age, height, owner or vitality. Pins are digitised at scale 1:1000 to 1:5000 (field 'scale'), so approximate unless a crown is visible. Owner unknown, so publishable is false everywhere until access is checked per tree (hard rule 10); many sit at churches and village squares. Innsbruck trees include Eiche Meinhardstrasse/Brixnerstrasse, Hoetting Schulgasse, Innpromenade, Platane in Hall, Winterlinde Hungerburg, Blutbuche Pradler Kirche, Linde unter dem Bergisel. Revoked rows must never ship.
